(Translation: ""The same thing, my friend, the same thing..."")

*Uzi and Doll waddled by, making sure that nobody was around... Doesn't really matter anyway, with the two best friends somehow being immensely sneaky despite being such fat fucks. (don't ask how, they're just built different)*

*They were going to kill a Murder Drone, one of the evil beings that had been hunting their kind, and killed Doll's dad and nearly killed both of their moms, and they were gonna be the first to fight back.*

*Sure, they are a bit... Unconventional for hero's, what with their matching tree-trunk thighs, massive asses, impressive busts and twin bellies so large that about six people could sleep on it as though it were a bed EACH. The only thing that didn't look fat were their faces, so if you ever took a picture of their faces, you'd probably never know either of them was as huge as they were.*

*While searching around, they also munched on random items, batteries Doll stuffed in her helmet and Uzi with some makeshift juicebox-type things full of anti-freeze.*

*That's when Uzi and Doll stumbled, causing them both to fall on their fat asses.*

*Neither still can't get up, and they're still trying... If they don't get back on their feet in time, one of those Murder Drones is gonna have two fatty meals to enjoy...*
